prompts.title: Racha reciente: forma de ambos equipos
prompts.prompt: Direction form, vertical 9:16, duration 8 seconds. EDITORIAL variant 'Ritmo de campeones': kinetic typography on GoatLab charcoal #101412 background. Spanish heading 'ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS' in warm white #edf0e6 condensed uppercase enters letter by letter with rhythmic scale pulses synced to a beat. Two team blocks: 'FC Barcelona' in lime #c5ed74 and 'Real Madrid CF' in slate #8ca6bf, each followed by a row of five abstract match glyphs (circles) that pop in one by one with elastic overshoot; the winning glyphs flash brighter. A diagonal wipe transition moves from the Barcelona block to the Madrid block. Camera: subtle vertical drift. Exit: glyphs collapse into a single line and slide out bottom. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. STATISTICAL variant 'Forma comparada': grouped count bars, shared zero baseline at the lower third, common scale sized to the larger count. Two clusters: FC Barcelona with bars for victorias {{home.wins}}, empates {{home.draws}}, derrotas {{home.losses}} over a sample of {{home.n}} partidos; Real Madrid CF with victorias {{away.wins}}, empates {{away.draws}}, derrotas {{away.losses}} over a sample of {{away.n}} partidos. Spanish labels under each cluster; units 'partidos'. Both samples are equal, so annotate 'Muestra: 5 partidos por equipo' in slate small type. Barcelona bars in lime, Madrid bars in slate, baseline in warm white. Bars grow from the baseline with staggered ease-out; the victorias bars receive a lime glow emphasis pulse. Source annotation 'Fuente: Bzzoioi' bottom-left above the subtitle band. Lower quarter reserved permanently for yellow subtitles. Transition between variants: horizontal wipe. Exit: bars retract to baseline, title fades.

prompts.title: Goles a favor y en contra
prompts.prompt: Direction goals, vertical 9:16, duration 8 seconds. EDITORIAL variant 'Camino del balón': stylised top-down football pitch in dark charcoal #101412 with lime #c5ed74 line markings, drawn with a light-stroke reveal. A glowing ball travels an animated path from midfield toward the Barcelona goal area, leaving a warm white #edf0e6 trail; Spanish heading 'PELIGRO EN AMBAS ÁREAS' appears top. The path splits into two branches tinted lime (FC Barcelona) and slate #8ca6bf (Real Madrid CF), suggesting both attacks. Camera: slow push-in following the ball. Emphasis: the ball pulses at each branch point. Exit: the trail dissolves into particles and the heading fades. No statistics, no invented match events. STATISTICAL variant 'Goles comparados': paired horizontal bars for both teams on one shared scale in goles, zero baseline at left. FC Barcelona: goles a favor {{home.gf}} (lime bar), goles recibidos {{home.ga}} (outlined warm white bar). Real Madrid CF: goles a favor {{away.gf}} (slate bar), goles recibidos {{away.ga}} (outlined warm white bar). Spanish labels 'A FAVOR' and 'EN CONTRA' as column headers so the pairing is unambiguous; football context line 'Últimos 5 partidos de LaLiga' in slate. Bars extend from the shared baseline with staggered ease; the a-favor bars get a brief glow emphasis. Source annotation 'Fuente: Bzzoioi · muestra: 5 partidos por equipo' bottom-left. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: pitch fades to charcoal, bars slide in from left. Exit: bars retract, labels fade to black.

prompts.title: Arcos en cero
prompts.prompt: Direction clean-sheets, vertical 9:16, duration 7 seconds. EDITORIAL variant 'Muro defensivo': defensive energy sequence on charcoal #101412. A stylised shield outline in warm white #edf0e6 draws itself center-frame with a light-stroke animation; inside, concentric lime #c5ed74 rings pulse outward like a protective barrier. Spanish heading 'ARCOS EN CERO' slams in above with a shake. A second shield in slate #8ca6bf slides in below for Real Madrid CF, both shields facing each other. Camera: slight dolly-in on the first shield, then rack to the second. Emphasis: the lime shield flashes when a stylised ball bounces off it. Exit: shields shrink and merge into a single dot that fades. No axes, no sample claims. STATISTICAL variant 'Porterías imbatidas': two vertical count bars on a shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos, never converted into rates. FC Barcelona: arcos en cero {{home.clean}} in lime, with sample note 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos'. Real Madrid CF: arcos en cero {{away.clean}} in slate, with sample note 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos'. Spanish labels under each bar; unit 'partidos'. Bars rise with ease-out and a small overshoot; a warm white tick marks each count on the shared scale. Emphasis: both counts receive an equal glow so neither dominates unfairly. Source annotation 'Fuente: Bzzoioi' bottom-left. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: shield crossfade to bars. Exit: bars drop to baseline, title fades out.

prompts.title: Historial de cruces
prompts.prompt: Direction head-to-head, vertical 9:16, duration 9 seconds. EDITORIAL variant 'El duelo eterno': both teams as a visual duel on charcoal #101412. Split screen: left half washes lime #c5ed74 for FC Barcelona, right half slate #8ca6bf for Real Madrid CF, divided by a jagged warm white #edf0e6 lightning seam that crackles with animated energy. Spanish heading 'EL CLÁSICO' in huge condensed type lands center with a screen shake; subtitle 'Historial de cruces' fades in below. The two halves push toward each other in a slow collision, the seam flaring brighter at the closest point. Camera: symmetrical push-in. Emphasis: the seam flash. Exit: the seam splits the frame open to black. No statistics, no forecast claims. STATISTICAL variant 'Cruces previos': horizontal count bars on a shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos. FC Barcelona victorias en cruces {{h2h.homeWins}} (lime), Real Madrid CF victorias en cruces {{h2h.awayWins}} (slate), Empates en cruces {{h2h.draws}} (outlined warm white). Total sample annotation 'Muestra: {{h2h.total}} partidos' in slate under the title. Spanish labels left of each bar; unit 'partidos'. Bars extend with staggered ease-out; the Barcelona bar receives a lime glow emphasis as the largest count. A warm white vertical tick marks each value on the shared scale. Historical disclaimer in Spanish small type: 'El historial no es un pronóstico'. Source annotation 'Fuente: Bzzoioi' bottom-left. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: lightning seam wipes into the bar chart. Exit: bars retract, disclaimer holds one beat, fade to black.

prompts.title: La tensión del duelo
prompts.prompt: Direction synthesis, vertical 9:16, duration 9 seconds. EDITORIAL variant 'Dos gigantes, una noche': team reveals and narrative emphasis on charcoal #101412. First, FC Barcelona reveals: a lime #c5ed74 crest-like geometric emblem assembles from rotating shards, Spanish caption 'FC BARCELONA' in warm white #edf0e6. Then Real Madrid CF reveals: slate #8ca6bf emblem, caption 'REAL MADRID CF'. The two emblems slide toward center and lock into a versus lockup with a spark burst. Spanish heading 'DOS ATAQUES, UNA FINAL' pulses once. Camera: slow orbit on the lockup. Emphasis: the spark burst at lock. Exit: emblems split apart and slide off opposite edges. No statistics, no invented events. STATISTICAL variant 'La tensión en números': one grounded tension — two elite attacks. Paired horizontal bars on a shared scale in goles: FC Barcelona goles a favor {{home.gf}} (lime) versus Real Madrid CF goles a favor {{away.gf}} (slate), zero baseline left, Spanish labels 'GOLES A FAVOR' and unit 'goles'. Below, a secondary scorer strip: Raphinha {{home.player0.goals}} goles (lime dot, source 'Tabla de goleadores') versus Kylian Mbappé {{away.player0.goals}} goles (slate dot, same source). Both blocks share the same goles scale so the comparison is valid; the team bars aggregate over a sample of 5 partidos per side, annotated 'Muestra: 5 partidos por equipo · Fuente: Bzzoioi'; the scorer strip is season scoring, annotated 'Fuente: Tabla de goleadores'. Spanish labels distinguish 'Historial reciente' from 'Goleadores de la temporada'. Emphasis: the larger a-favor bar glows lime. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Transition: versus lockup dissolves into bars. Exit: bars retract, heading fades to black.
